text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, a letter from a fan arrives for
Fine
Motion.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
Excuse the intrusion, but please allow
me to
confirm the letter's contents first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's security captain suddenly
appears
and promptly looks over the
letter.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
I have confirmed that the letter poses no
danger.
Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I would love to unseal it myself, but you
just
never know. I was raised to be
cautious.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Fine Motion, watching you has
given me
courage."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"My parents told me that it was absurd
for the
daughter of a prestigious family
to race, so I was
about to give up on my
dream—until I heard
about you."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I saw how dedicated you are to both
racing and
your family's duties. I want to
chase my dream just
like you."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I hope that one day we might meet on
the turf.
Until then, I'll continue
watching and cheering for
you."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was only running to fulfill my own
dream—I
never imagined that my efforts
could affect the
dreams of other people
too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I hope we can clash at full strength in
the most
incredible races as we continue
ever onward down
our respective
paths—laughing all the while.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The heartfelt message of the fan letter
provides
Fine Motion with a great boost
of motivation.
